children: Argentina trimmed its forecast for the country's 2026/27 soybean harvest to 47.8 million metric tons, while raising its outlook for 2026/27 corn production to between 67.5 million and 70.5 million tons, Rosario grains exchange said on Wednesday.
Last month, the exchange had projected soybean output at 48 million tons and corn production at 66 million tons.
For 2026/27 wheat, the Rosario exchange raised its harvest estimate by 500,000 tons to 21 million tons.
